name: prepare_query_tuning
description: Analyze a slow query on a temporary branch and return a tuning_id. Apply suggested SQL with run_sql on that branch, re-run explain_sql_statement there, then complete_query_tuning with the tuning_id (not the branch id) — apply_changes true if they accept, omit it or pass false if they reject, so the temporary branch is deleted. Do not use prepare_database_migration.

database_name.description: The name of the database to execute the query against

project_id.description: The ID of the project to execute the query against. Required for an unscoped connection. May be omitted when the connection is scoped to one project; if provided, it must match that project.

role_name.description: The name of the role to connect with. If not provided, the default role (usually "neondb_owner") will be used.

sql.description: The SQL statement to analyze and tune
